description: Entrypoint for V2 creative review records. The rubric record schema is now registered (references/review-rubric-schema.json, id urn:blackceo:motion:review-rubric:1.0, registered by MG-033), so this entrypoint resolves to it. Before MG-033 it pointed at the generic result definition in contracts-v2.schema.json because no rubric record schema existed. Review tooling (scripts/review_rubric.py) validates records against the rubric schema directly. The canonical contracts schema is unchanged.
